hypothesis: A low-capacity differentiable mapping from multiscale static catchment attributes to bounded HBV parameters can improve transferable total-flow prediction while retaining exact HBV mass conservation; independent state products may subsequently constrain internal response states.

registered_candidates.DPL_HBV_LOCAL_STATIC: seven local static attributes -> 16 hidden units -> eight bounded raw-parameter offsets
registered_candidates.DPL_HBV_MULTISCALE_STATIC: local attributes + upstream mean/std + area (22 inputs) -> 16 hidden units -> eight bounded raw-parameter offsets
registered_candidates.DPL_HBV_MULTISCALE_STATE: only after independent-state QA and static DPL gate
registered_candidates.MC_FLUX_GATE_DIAGNOSTIC: only bounded mass-conserving infiltration and fast/slow transfer gates after static DPL evaluation

parameter_mapping_contract.final_layer_initialization: all zeros so epoch 0 exactly reproduces the frozen parent
parameter_mapping_contract.raw_offset_bound: parent raw value +/- 1.5 for every Reach and parameter

time_contract.locked_retrospective: 2019-2022 after all development decisions and full-development parameter lock

spatial_contract.target_tree_Q_2010_2018: completely excluded from mapping-network optimization, early stopping and model selection
spatial_contract.target_station_history: zero target-tree discharge history may enter prediction
spatial_contract.loss_weighting: equal terminal-tree weight, then equal station weight within tree

gates.flow_regimes: high-flow and low-flow must each be noninferior
gates.seed_consistency: at least 2 of 3 registered seeds agree in direction
gates.promotion: all temporal and full-tree gates pass, and temporal or spatial CI95 upper < 0

independent_state_contract.minimum_support_for_H2: ESA CCI, GRACE and PML: at least two improve; SMAP must not clearly worsen

authorization_levels.H1: total flow supported; response components internal only
authorization_levels.H2: response components compatible with independent states and usable for structured sensitivity
authorization_levels.H3: components independently identified by tracer or conductivity evidence

forbidden: TN observations in hydrologic fitting, early stopping or model selection
Gauge/P2 station-history correction in the 230-Reach product
target-tree or target-station discharge history in spatial evaluation
station identity, station random intercepts or terminal-tree random intercepts
unrestricted residual LSTM or neural total-flow correction as the TN interface
daily neural rewriting of all HBV parameters in the first candidate round
Andreadis reference discharge or upstream area; only width and depth may be used
claims of observed surface water, groundwater, new water, old water or water age without H3 evidence
software_preflight: Use a dedicated PyTorch environment; do not bypass OpenMP conflicts with unsafe duplicate-library environment flags.
